question:
Study the following graph and answer the given question.

The following bar graph shows annual exports (in crore) of a company during the period 2015 to 2019.

What is the average export (in crore) of the year 2016 and 2018?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffa1ca6d9ed2e4cd8444511bae10fe6f9127c5120449c44fc480e63f705be468.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Exports in 2016 = ₹20 crore

Exports in 2018 = ₹40 crore

**Formula used:**

Average = frac{{Sum of exports}}{{Number of years}}

**Calculation:**

Average = (20+40)/(2)

⇒ (60)/(2)

⇒ 30 crore

**∴ The average export (in crore) for the years 2016 and 2018 is ₹30 crore.**
